summary: AGM Group Holdings filed a 6-K disclosing a September 10, 2026 Share Transfer Agreement to sell its 55% stake in KOI Global Ltd., a BVI-incorporated operating subsidiary providing core technology services in Hong Kong, to Mr. Yuqiang Huang, holder of the remaining 45%. The company will divest all 550 shares held for total cash consideration of US$2,450,000, implying roughly $4.45 million equity value for the target. Upon closing, subject to conditions precedent, the transferee holds 100% and AGM ceases control. No advisor or board recommendation named; watch closing conditions and any lingering guarantees or indemnities to the divested unit.
